info.name: LKP Activity 1.3 MongoDB CRUD
info.description: Demonstrates MongoDB-backed Project CRUD through the LKP Express API. The server seeds mock project records when the collection is empty. Do not use real personal data or place credentials in this collection.

exec: pm.test('API responds with HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('List responds with HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response contains an array of projects', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('Update responds with HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
